mutants.label: case.toml 'mode' validation disabled
mutants.why: Killed by test_missing_mode_is_rejected and test_invalid_mode_is_rejected: with the check dropped, a case.toml with a missing or bogus mode no longer raises.

mutants.label: build_dispatch_prompt reads and appends acceptance.md
mutants.why: Killed by test_build_dispatch_prompt_does_not_leak_acceptance_text_even_when_prompt_embeds_it: the acceptance-only marker text would leak into the dispatch prompt.

mutants.label: [does-nothing] build_dispatch_prompt returns every file in the case directory concatenated
mutants.why: Killed by test_build_dispatch_prompt_does_not_leak_acceptance_text_even_when_prompt_embeds_it: concatenating every file in the case directory includes acceptance.md's text.
mutants.replace: return "".join(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8") for p in sorted(case_dir.iterdir()) if p.is_file())

mutants.label: build_no_skill_prompt stops stripping the skill-naming lines
mutants.why: Killed by test_build_no_skill_prompt_omits_skill_name_and_adds_instruction: the rostered skill's name would still appear in the no-skill prompt.
mutants.find: kept_lines = [line for line in prompt_text.splitlines() if skill not in line]

mutants.label: build_no_skill_prompt drops the do-not-invoke-any-skill instruction
mutants.why: Killed by test_build_no_skill_prompt_omits_skill_name_and_adds_instruction: the fixed instruction sentence would no longer appear in the output.

mutants.label: _combined_status ignores non-complete transcript statuses
mutants.why: Killed by test_score_attempt_truncated_transcript_is_indeterminate: a truncated transcript would be scored as if it were complete.

mutants.label: envelope_parsed always reports True
mutants.why: Killed by test_score_attempt_findings_envelope_parse_failure_scores_miss_with_parse_error: an unparseable findings envelope would no longer set parse_error.
mutants.find: envelope_parsed = all(per_transcript_ok) if uses_findings_envelope else True

mutants.label: [does-nothing] score_attempt never calls any item's scorer
mutants.why: Killed by test_score_attempt_hits_via_synthetic_predicate: every item would score a miss regardless of the transcript.
mutants.replace: item_hits = {item["id"]: False for item in items}

mutants.label: gated_ids validation dropped
mutants.why: Killed by test_score_attempt_rejects_a_gated_id_not_in_case_toml: a gated id naming no item in case.toml would no longer raise.

mutants.label: unmatched-finding count always reports 0
mutants.why: Killed by test_score_attempt_counts_unmatched_findings_for_findings_envelope_case: the unrelated bar.py finding would no longer count as unmatched.

mutants.label: score_attempt never loads end-state evidence
mutants.why: Killed by test_snapshot_end_state_then_rescore_from_raws_matches_the_live_score: an end-state-based scorer would always see an empty end_state and miss.

mutants.label: duplicate item-id detection disabled
mutants.why: Killed by test_duplicate_item_id_within_one_skill_across_cases_is_detected: two cases sharing an item id within one skill would no longer be flagged.
